body: I hear the dull thudding of footsteps approaching. Fear clenches my stomach, but I force myself to stand firm, eyes locked on the wall. My heart races as they draw closer, every step echoing like a warning bell. Suddenly, one person falls over near the doorframe, clutching their chest. A gasp escapes me before I can hold back my tears. "Please don't hurt them," I whisper, hoping against hope. My mind races, desperately trying to think of a way out.
